svg.title: Riju performs the production go-live as Cecil stamps the deployment record.
svg.desc: In close-up, Riju's finger presses the terminal's replaced blue key while Cecil's right-side stamp plate hits the paper at the same instant. The sole production activation begins as a cyan pulse, with LIVE added later as deterministic lettering.
svg.text: Page 26, panel 5 · Close-up on Riju and Cecil at the final countdown beat

text.tspan: Riju performs the sole production go-live of the
Crosswalk as Cecil records the live deployment.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
